title: Bug 646141: Forward-port Subcontracting Dispatch List action from 28.x to main
summary: Subcontracting app gains an app-owned Subcontractor Dispatch List action replacing the legacy Base Application one, while preserving the old action with an obsolete caption to prevent AppSourceCop baseline breaks.
key_points: Added app-owned 'Subcontractor Dispatch List' action to Subcontracting page extension
Removed obsolete app-side modification of the legacy Base Application action
Changed Base Application legacy action caption to 'Subcontractor - Dispatch List (Obsolete)' for clarity
Updated UI tests to reference the new app-owned action identifier
Resolves AppSourceCop baseline break AS0031 when upgrading to version 28.5.53301.0
